protocol: Labelled by hand from the source files before the extractor was run on them. decision: the notes record that the group decided, agreed, approved or resolved something, or reached consensus. open_question: a question about what to do that the notes leave unresolved (questions answered later in the notes are not labelled). proposal: a suggestion put to the group that is not recorded as decided. ambiguous: true marks borderline sentences (action items, deferrals, agenda boilerplate, tentative plans, answered or rhetorical questions); they count neither for nor against the extractor. Each label text is a verbatim span of the prepared document, compared after whitespace and case normalisation.
